notes.start: the base's parking spot for the unit (modern-iaf/data/airbases, airbases.md §5); the altitude: the terrain's ground there (elevation_m without the terrain)
notes.route: the departure point: 10 km beyond runway 26L's far end on its heading, 900 m above the field
notes.training.empty_kg: the F-35A's empty weight; the F-35I's is not published (inferred the same)
notes.training.takeoff_kt: one figure for every weight: no public table by weight
notes.training.time_budget_s: fifteen minutes from the mission's start for the start-up, the tower calls, the taxi and the take-off
notes.training.heading_tolerance_deg: the climb-out on the runway heading within 10 degrees
notes.training.end_hold_s: the mission ends 5 s after its goal: time to see the result before the debrief

footnotes.oa: OurAirports, airports.csv (public domain; LLNV elevation 1330 ft), https://davidmegginson.github.io/ourairports-data/airports.csv
footnotes.wn-f35: WION, "How does the F-35 fighter jet stand out in take-off speed" (minimum lift-off speed about 165 kt; weak), https://www.wionews.com/photos/how-does-the-f-35-fighter-jet-stand-out-in-takeoff-speed-and-design-here-s-its-minimum-lift-off-speed-1752767093279
footnotes.w-f35-spec: Wikipedia, "Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II", Specifications (F-35A): empty weight 29,300 lb (13,290 kg), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lockheed_Martin_F-35_Lightning_II

briefing.en: Taxi to runway 26L and take off on its heading.

win.en: Mission - successful. Airborne with the gear up.
win.he: המשימה הצליחה. באוויר עם כן נסע אסוף.

wait.en: wait for idle with the avionics up

steps.en: Taxi to runway {runway} and stop short of it

wait.en: wait for "line up", line up and ask again: wait for "cleared for take-off"
wait.he: המתנה ל"כניסה למסלול", כניסה למסלול ובקשה חוזרת: המתנה ל"מאושר להמריא"

steps.en: Take off on the runway heading, gear up (±{tolerance}°)
steps.he: המראה בכיוון המסלול, איסוף כן הנסע (±{tolerance}°)
